verdict.rationale: EFTPS's core transaction is paying federal taxes, and its own pages say payments can be made online 24/7 from home or office. The service covers income, employment, estimated and excise taxes, with scheduling up to 365 days ahead, change/cancel, immediate acknowledgement and payment history. However, first-time enrollment ends with a PIN sent by U.S. Mail (5–7 business days) after up to five business days of processing, so a new founder cannot complete the first payment end-to-end online. Missing for 10: fully online onboarding (no mailed PIN), independent or hands-on corroboration that the online payment flow works as described.
